system.description:
A Deteriorating creature suffers the effects of their body and physical form falling apart.

A Deteriorating creature grants attacking creatures a +1 bonus to their critical hit range, for each rank they have.

A creature with 3 or more ranks of Deteriorate loses all Resistances they have.

A creature with 5 ranks of Deteriorate loses all Immunities they have

Creatures that are immune to Acid damage is immune to this condition.

A Deteriorating creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends.
system.summary: +1 critical range against it per rank; loses its resistances at 3 ranks and immunities at 5; DC 20 Constitution to end.
